notes: Two additions. (1) Install Syncro agent: a button on the ticket bar installs your Syncro RMM agent on this PC for the active ticket's customer — paste your installer link once in Settings. It only downloads from Syncro addresses and now only runs the installer if it's validly signed BY Syncro/RepairTech. (2) Theme fix: switching away from a preset (e.g. Oaklands) no longer leaves its logo, app icon or title-bar name behind. Note: the agent installer flow hasn't been tested on a live Windows install yet — try it on a test PC first.
